title: Hanasato Minori — Profile Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone!
Today, as requested by our fans, we'll be showing you our self-intros!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Starting with me, Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm actually a little nervous about doing this again, but... I-I hope you'll listen...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin♪
Here's a bouquet of hope for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, when I was in elementary school and Haruka was still with ASRUN, I decided that I wanted to become an idol just like her...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I failed basically every audition I tried for and started living each day totally frustrated.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I was able to meet my wonderful friends and form MORE MORE JUMP! because I kept trying. And just recently...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We finally got to put on our very own solo show! Let's give us a round of applause!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As a huge fan of idols, I felt like I had a good understanding of how hard it is to actually put on a solo show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And that gave me an even greater appreciation for you, our fans. Our show wouldn't have been possible without you guys...! I'm beyond grateful for your support!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I'd like to take this opportunity to say...! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
This doesn't feel like a self-intro anymore...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Uhh... Anyway!
We're gonna keep spreading hope to as many people as we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
It's my self-intro, so I should talk about myself more?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-U-Uhh...
Then, I'll talk about what I'm best at!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm really good at imitating dance routines, and believe I can learn them faster than anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I get that learning them and performing them well are pretty different things...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Airi gave me some pointers for dancing the other day, and some of our fans even said that I've gotten better lately!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-So, I know I still have a lot of work left to do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I'm gonna keep trying my best!
And I'm looking forward to your continued support!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-How was that...?
Did I do okay...?! Here, I'll take a look at everyone's comments!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“You sound way too nervous”...
“I guess this self-intro suits you, Minori”...
“Maybe try to relax a little more? lol”...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why is it so hard to give a good self-intro?!
